items.q: What services does your agency offer?
items.a: We focus on five things: business websites, CMS development, PPC landing pages, SEO & AEO optimisation, and fixing or redesigning existing websites – everything a business needs to look credible, get found and convert.

items.q: What is a CMS and do I need one?
items.a: A CMS (Content Management System) such as WordPress or Webflow lets you edit pages, blogs and images yourself without touching code. If you plan to update your site regularly, yes – we will recommend the best fit and train your team.

items.q: How are PPC landing pages different from a normal website?
items.a: A PPC landing page has one goal: turn paid clicks from Google or Meta Ads into leads or sales. They are fast, distraction-free and message-matched to your ad, which lowers your cost per lead.

items.q: What is AEO and how is it different from SEO?
items.a: SEO helps you rank in search results. AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) structures your content and schema so AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity can understand and cite your business. We do both.

items.q: How long does a website project take?
items.a: A typical business website takes 3–6 weeks. Landing pages can go live in 1–2 weeks. You will get a clear timeline after our free consultation.

items.q: Do you provide support after launch?
items.a: Yes. We offer maintenance, hosting guidance, security updates and monthly SEO and performance reporting so your website keeps improving.
